example: 4D Minkowski: g=-du^2-2du dr+r^2 dOmega_2^2, Omega=1/r, rho=1/r, gtilde=Omega^2 g extends to rho=0=I+.
calculation: Outgoing radial null geodesic has physical affine parameter lambda proportional to r, so lambda diverges at I+.
For gtilde=Omega^2 g, d tilde_lambda/d lambda is proportional to Omega^2=1/r^2 along a null geodesic.
Hence tilde_lambda reaches a finite endpoint while lambda diverges.
conclusion: Physical affine completeness is not equivalent to affine completeness of the unphysical conformal parameter.
required_action: Choose one F1 completeness convention and remove unsupported equivalence or provide a precise theorem.
